item.title: 'When will we stop telling women what to wear': Sanon to Kangana over Rakhi remarks
item.summary: Kriti Sanon recently responded to criticism surrounding her outfit in a Rakshabandhan commercial. She passionately articulated that the true essence of the festival is rooted in emotions rather than clothing preferences. Sanon challenged the norm of judging women based on their wardrobe choices, insisting that cultural values and traditions are founded in one's heart. Meanwhile, her film 'Cocktail 2' debuted in June 2026.
